reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International as a business opportunity, instructs viewers to recruit referrals, help them fund accounts with Bitcoin, and build teams. It presents team growth as a path to “financial freedom” and directs viewers to contact the sender for further participation, establishing a concrete recruitment and money-flow solicitation rather than reporting or criticism.

citations.quote: If you are giving out your referral link, this means you intend to build a team.
If they have joined and not yet funded their account, ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin
Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need.
You will see a list of all the people who have joined using your referral link and you will find their email addresses listed and their mobile number.
you can guide them in building a team of their own, and this can often be done in conjunction with your sponsor.

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker does not promise a fixed return or say that every contact must fund an account. The guidance distinguishes people who have already funded from those who have not, and tells the viewer to ask whether a new member is familiar with Bitcoin and answer their questions. The closing describes financial freedom as an opportunity, not a guaranteed outcome. That language can be read as guidance for existing members supporting people who joined through their links, rather than a claim that joining will make anyone wealthy.

citations.quote: If they have joined and funded their account, welcome them to your business
ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin and if necessary provide them with information to help them get started with Bitcoin.
answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need.
this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution correctly identifies referrals, Bitcoin funding and team-building, but those excerpts do not establish a promised return or a commission paid for recruitment. The funding instruction is paired with answering questions, while the team-building instruction concerns people who have already joined. Those distinctions matter before treating member support as proof of deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need.
you can guide them in building a team of their own, and this can often be done in conjunction with your sponsor.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A guarantee or stated commission rate is not needed to recognize what the video promotes. It instructs viewers to help unfunded referrals put money into accounts, then encourages those recruits to build teams of their own. The financial-freedom language supplies the incentive for that process; the questions and assistance do not turn it into neutral education.

citations.quote: Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need.
you can guide them in building a team of their own, and this can often be done in conjunction with your sponsor.
this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom.

opening.argument: Judge, the immediate subject is how a member follows up with people who have already used a referral link. The speaker gives a concrete navigation step for finding those members and their contact details, points them toward a video channel, and suggests helping with Bitcoin questions. That is substantial operational instruction. The video can therefore be read primarily as a member-support tutorial, even though its setting is a referral-based business.

citations.quote: When someone joins using you referral link, it is your duty to follow up with that person.
To get the details of these people go to Direct Referrals and click on See Detailed Report.
Tell them about the video channel and ask them if they need assistance with anything.
ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin and if necessary provide them with information to help them get started with Bitcoin.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution reads the workflow as recruitment, but its quoted report and contact-details instruction also has a straightforward tutorial function: it tells existing members where to find people who already joined. The opening expressly addresses what to do after someone uses a referral link. The financial-freedom statement is promotional context, but it does not erase the video's step-by-step member-support content.

citations.quote: When someone joins using you referral link, it is your duty to follow up with that person.
To get the details of these people go to Direct Referrals and click on See Detailed Report.
this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The navigation steps serve the pitch rather than standing apart from it. Members are told to find referrals, contact those who have not funded, assist with funding, and help them build teams. A tutorial format does not make those instructions neutral when the stated goal is growing a business presented as a route to financial freedom.

citations.quote: To get the details of these people go to Direct Referrals and click on See Detailed Report.
If they have joined and not yet funded their account, ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin
you can guide them in building a team of their own, and this can often be done in conjunction with your sponsor.
this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom.

opening.argument: Judge, the described mechanics are a referral link, follow-up with people who used it, and help with their questions. The presentation also shows a direct-referrals report. None of that, by itself, states a commission rate, a payment for adding members, or a guaranteed return. The speaker does discuss funding accounts, but the cited instruction does not say funds go to the referrer. On this record, an ordinary referral promotion remains a plausible reading without certifying the underlying service as safe.

citations.quote: If you are giving out your referral link, this means you intend to build a team.
To get the details of these people go to Direct Referrals and click on See Detailed Report.
Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have, and forward any information they need.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's evidence shows a referral network and account funding, but it stops short of showing how the referrer is paid or that recruits must pay to join a tier. Even the instruction to guide others in building teams states no downline payout. A branching structure and a broad aspiration to financial freedom are concerning, but neither supplies those missing transaction terms.

citations.quote: you can guide them in building a team of their own, and this can often be done in conjunction with your sponsor.
this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absent commission terms limit what can be claimed about the precise payout mechanism; they do not make the promotion ordinary. The video connects distributing referral links to building a team, directs members to help referrals fund accounts, and urges them to develop teams of their own. It then presents that business-building process as a path to financial freedom.
